John swims the 1500 m in 25 minutes. Find his average speed, in km/h, for this swim.
John completes the 40 km bike ride at an average speed of 32 km/h. Find the time, in minutes, for John to complete this bike ride.
John completes the whole race at an average speed of 20.6 km/h. Find the average speed, in km/h, for John to complete his 10 km run.
Find the median Spanish mark.
Find the mean French mark.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x.
Use your equation to estimate the Spanish mark when the French mark is 50
Use your equation to estimate the Spanish mark when the French mark is 6.
Which French mark, 50 or 6, is likely to give the most reliable Spanish mark? Give a reason for your answer.
$x is divided in the ratio 3:5. The larger share is $42. Find the value of x.
Increase 124 by 16%.
The price of a coat is reduced by 2/9 in a sale. The new price of the coat is $73.50. Find the original price of the coat.
Xiong invests $2000 in Bank A which pays simple interest at a rate of 3% each year. Find the total amount of interest Xiong receives at the end of 5 years.
Wendi invests $400 in Bank B which pays compound interest at a rate of 1.6% each year. Find the total amount of interest Wendi receives at the end of 3 years.

Pedro invests $1000 in Bank C for 18 years. Pedro also invests $1000 in Bank D for 18 years. Bank C pays simple interest at a rate of x% each year. Bank D pays compound interest at a rate of 0.7x% each year. At the end of 18 years Pedro has exactly the same amount of money in Bank C and Bank D. Show that 1 + (18x)/100 = (1 + (0.7x)/100)^18.
Given that 5 < x < 7, use a graphical method to find x.
In the diagram, AB is parallel to ED. ACD and BCE are straight lines. AB = 50 cm, BC = 55 cm and AC = 64 cm. Show that angle ACB = 49.0° correct to one decimal place.
Use the sine rule to calculate angle CAB.
Calculate the area of triangle ABC.
AC = 2/3 AD. Calculate the area of triangle CDE.
Solve. 7x - 5 = 3x + 13
Solve. 1 - 2x^2 = 5x - 1. Give your answer correct to two decimal places.
log x = 1 + 4 log y. Find x in terms of y.

There are 12 balls in a bag, n of them are blue. A ball is taken from the bag at random and replaced. The probability that the ball is blue is p. 6 more blue balls are added to the bag. A ball is taken from the bag at random. The probability that this ball is blue is 2p. Find the value of p.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for f(x) = |2 cos(x - 45)°| - 1 between -90 and 90.
Write down the x-coordinates of the points where the curve meets the x-axis.
Write down the coordinates of the local maximum point.
The line y = 0.005x intersects the curve y = |2 cos(x - 45)°| - 1 three times. Find the x-coordinates of the points of intersection.
Solve the inequality |2 cos(x - 45)°| - 1 > 0.005x
Solve the simultaneous equations 5x - 4y = 13 and 3x + 2y = -1. You must show all your working.
Find f(f(x)), giving your answer in its simplest form.
Solve g(f(x)) = 1/5.
A student is chosen at random from the 80 students. Find the probability that the student chosen is a girl whose favourite sport is athletics
A student is chosen at random from the 80 students. Find the probability that the student chosen is a boy whose favourite sport is not football.
One of the girls is chosen at random. Find the probability that her favourite sport is hockey.
Three of the boys are chosen at random. Find the probability that one of the boys chooses athletics, one of them chooses football and the other chooses swimming.
Calculate the probability that the three boys each have a different favourite sport.
A, B, C and D lie on a circle, centre O. DE is a tangent to the circle at D. ACE is a straight line. Find angle AOC
Find angle OAC
Find angle ADC
Find angle CAD.
The diagram shows a cuboid with base ABCD. AB = 20 cm, BC = 34 cm and CE = 16 cm. Water is poured into the cuboid to a height of 8 cm. Find the volume of water in the cuboid.
A sphere of radius 4 cm is placed so that it rests on the base of the cuboid. The water level is now q cm above the base of the cuboid. Find the value of q.
The sphere is removed from the cuboid. 15 identical cubes of side x cm are placed so that they rest on the base of the cuboid. Find the maximum value of x.
The water level is now p cm above the base of the cuboid. Find the maximum value of p.
The diagram shows two right-angled triangles ABC and CBD. AB = BC, AC = −200 cm and angle BDC = 30�. Find the perimeter of triangle ACD.
